storyCards.headline: Smooth: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Santana's "Smooth" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Smooth" is a song performed by American rock band Santana and Rob Thomas of Matchbox Twenty, who sings the lead vocals.

It was released to radio on June 15, 1999, as the lead single from Santana's 1999 studio album, Supernatural, and was physically released as a single in August.

It was written by Itaal Shur and Thomas, who re-wrote Shur's original melody and lyrics, and produced by Matt Serletic.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 58 weeks on the chart.
